therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: NK1 receptor antagonism and 5-HT3 receptor antagonism
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: prevention of chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: women with breast cancer receiving AC chemotherapy

results.effect_size: similar safety profile between IV and oral formulations
subgroup_findings: Complete response rates: acute phase 86.5% vs 88.6%, delayed phase 75.5% vs 78.7%, overall phase 73.0% vs 77.2%
safety_signals: Serious AEs included anemia, neutropenia, febrile neutropenia, atrial fibrillation, vomiting
results.dose_information: IV fosnetupitant/palonosetron 260 mg/0.25 mg vs oral netupitant/palonosetron 300 mg/0.50 mg, with dexamethasone 12 mg
